contributes.values:
falcosidekick:
  config:
    alertmanager:
      # Falco alerts go to the cluster's channels only: they carry
      # command lines from every namespace.
      hostport: http://vmalertmanager-vm-victoria-metrics-k8s-stack.observability.svc:9093
      # The chart's default is the v1 API, which Alertmanager 0.27 removed.
      endpoint: /api/v2/alerts
      # Notices are frequent and rarely need action.
      minimumpriority: warning
      # A Falco alert has no end. It ends 10 minutes after the last one.
      expireafter: "600"
      # The namespace label routes the alert to the cluster's channels;
      # the pod's namespace stays in k8s_ns_name.
      extralabels: "namespace:observability,zeabur_event:runtime-security,zeabur_kind:event"

metadata.name: VictoriaMetrics (k8s stack)
metadata.summary: Keeps metrics history and sends alerts to each project's notification channels.

releases.name: k8s-stack

profiles.multi-node:
vmsingle:
  spec:
    # Two weeks of history.
    retentionPeriod: 14d
    # Scrapes the same series per pod as single-node; the higher limit
    # leaves room for more nodes and pods.
    resources:
      requests: {cpu: 50m, memory: 224Mi}
      limits: {memory: 1Gi}
vmagent:
  spec:
    # More targets across nodes.
    resources:
      requests: {cpu: 20m, memory: 128Mi}
      limits: {memory: 512Mi}
profiles.single-node:
kubeControllerManager:
  # Embedded in k3s; nothing to scrape.
  enabled: false
kubeScheduler:
  # Embedded in k3s; nothing to scrape.
  enabled: false
kubeEtcd:
  # k3s single-node uses SQLite (kine), not etcd.
  enabled: false
vmsingle:
  spec:
    # A week of history on one node.
    retentionPeriod: 7d
    # Idles near 150Mi with 35 pods.
    resources:
      requests: {cpu: 50m, memory: 224Mi}
      limits: {memory: 512Mi}
vmagent:
  spec:
    # Small scrape set on one node. Idles near 85Mi.
    resources:
      requests: {cpu: 20m, memory: 128Mi}
      limits: {memory: 256Mi}

releases.values:
prometheus-node-exporter:
  # Pinned by digest; a tag alone can move. The chart joins registry and
  # repository. registry comes second, so Renovate reads both.
  image:
    repository: prometheus/node-exporter
    registry: quay.io
    tag: v1.12.1@sha256:1b4e4438faca4dd7e001dd445d161a4a2091b0fededa84093b3a8dfeae1f1be0
  # The chart compares this version, not the tag above, with semver; any
  # release from 1.4.0 on renders the same.
  version: 1.12.1
  # Node disk use (node_filesystem_*) has no other source; Zeabur reads it.
  enabled: true
  extraArgs:
    # Only the collectors the default node-exporter, node and kubernetes rules query.
    - --collector.disable-defaults
    - --collector.filesystem
    - --collector.cpu
    - --collector.meminfo
    - --collector.loadavg
    - --collector.vmstat
    - --collector.diskstats
    - --collector.netdev
    - --collector.netclass
    - --collector.filefd
    - --collector.conntrack
    - --collector.timex
    - --collector.mdadm
    - --collector.bonding
    - --collector.textfile
    # The chart's excludes plus containerd's per-pod shm mounts (k3s keeps them under /run/k3s).
    # /var/lib/kubelet itself stays visible; only mounts below it are dropped.
    - --collector.filesystem.mount-points-exclude=^/(dev|proc|sys|run/containerd/.+|run/k3s/.+|var/lib/docker/.+|var/lib/kubelet/.+)($|/)
    - --collector.filesystem.fs-types-exclude=^(autofs|binfmt_misc|bpf|cgroup2?|configfs|debugfs|devpts|devtmpfs|fusectl|hugetlbfs|iso9660|mqueue|nsfs|overlay|proc|procfs|pstore|rpc_pipefs|securityfs|selinuxfs|squashfs|erofs|sysfs|tracefs)$
  resources:
    # One small exporter per node, idles near 16Mi.
    requests: {cpu: 10m, memory: 16Mi}
    limits: {memory: 64Mi}
kubeApiServer:
  # Its histograms are ~half of all series; its alert rules go with it.
  enabled: false
kubelet:
  vmScrape:
    spec:
      metricRelabelConfigs:
        # Chart defaults: UIDs and cgroup ids only multiply series.
        - action: labeldrop
          regex: (uid)
        - action: labeldrop
          regex: (id|name)
        # The kubelet also exports API server and storage histograms (~45% of series on k3s).
        - action: drop
          source_labels: [__name__]
          regex: .+_bucket|(apiserver|etcd|kine|rest_client|workqueue|scheduler|authentication|authorization|aggregator|admission|watch_cache|storage)_.+
syncJob:
  # Pinned by digest; a tag alone can move.
  image:
    repository: ghcr.io/victoriametrics/sync-job
    tag: v0.0.17@sha256:b6f233532a85cda65e645264d24f995e5ee97f88b60610643f01f170516f444b
victoria-metrics-operator:
  # The operator is its own component, shared with logs.
  enabled: false
grafana:
  # Grafana adds ~150Mi; install it separately if needed.
  enabled: false
defaultDashboards:
  # Dashboards only matter with Grafana.
  enabled: false
kube-state-metrics:
  # Maps pods to workloads and exposes requests, limits and object state.
  enabled: true
  # Only the objects needed to map pods to workloads. Idles near 40Mi.
  resources:
    requests: {cpu: 10m, memory: 64Mi}
  collectors: [pods, replicasets, deployments, statefulsets, daemonsets, jobs, cronjobs, nodes, persistentvolumeclaims, namespaces]
  # Pinned by digest; a tag alone can move. The chart joins registry and
  # repository. registry comes second, so Renovate reads both.
  image:
    repository: kube-state-metrics/kube-state-metrics
    registry: registry.k8s.io
    tag: v2.20.0@sha256:42cfe3723a5f058171c627537fb57a3ea0f26e4380fa18555a95cb1a1b4cfc5b
  metricLabelsAllowlist:
    # Pods: map pods to apps. Jobs: a notification test names its channel in
    # this label. Namespaces: tell projects from the cluster's own namespaces.
    - pods=[app.kubernetes.io/name,app.kubernetes.io/component]
    - jobs=[zeabur.com/notification-test]
    - namespaces=[zeabur.com/project]
  rbac:
    # Read the objects the custom resource metrics below come from.
    extraRules:
      - apiGroups: [builder.zeabur.com]
        resources: [buildruns]
        verbs: [list, watch]
      - apiGroups: [postgresql.cnpg.io]
        resources: [clusters, backups]
        verbs: [list, watch]
      - apiGroups: [psmdb.percona.com]
        resources: [perconaservermongodbs, perconaservermongodbbackups]
        verbs: [list, watch]
      - apiGroups: [k8up.io]
        resources: [backups]
        verbs: [list, watch]
      - apiGroups: [velero.io]
        resources: [backups]
        verbs: [list, watch]
      - apiGroups: [cert-manager.io]
        resources: [certificates]
        verbs: [list, watch]
  customResourceState:
    # The status of builds, databases, backups and certificates as metrics,
    # for the notification rules (release notifications). A kind that is not
    # installed adds nothing. One series for each object: a Build keeps at
    # most its historyLimit of BuildRuns, Velero and K8up delete old
    # backups, but CloudNativePG and Percona keep every Backup object.
    # The scrape below drops their successful backups.
    enabled: true
    config:
      kind: CustomResourceStateMetrics
      spec:
        resources:
          - groupVersionKind: {group: builder.zeabur.com, version: v1alpha1, kind: BuildRun}
            metricNamePrefix: zeabur_builder_buildrun
            labelsFromPath:
              namespace: [metadata, namespace]
              buildrun: [metadata, name]
              build: [spec, buildRef]
              phase: [status, phase]
              reason: [status, reason]
            metrics:
              - name: completion_time
                help: When the BuildRun finished; absent while it runs.
                errorLogV: 5
                each:
                  type: Gauge
                  gauge: {path: [status, completionTime]}
          - groupVersionKind: {group: postgresql.cnpg.io, version: v1, kind: Cluster}
            metricNamePrefix: zeabur_cnpg_cluster
            labelsFromPath:
              namespace: [metadata, namespace]
              cluster: [metadata, name]
            metrics:
              - name: phase
                help: The CloudNativePG cluster's phase.
                each:
                  type: Info
                  info:
                    labelsFromPath:
                      phase: [status, phase]
          - groupVersionKind: {group: postgresql.cnpg.io, version: v1, kind: Backup}
            metricNamePrefix: zeabur_cnpg_backup
            labelsFromPath:
              namespace: [metadata, namespace]
              backup: [metadata, name]
              cluster: [spec, cluster, name]
              phase: [status, phase]
            metrics:
              - name: created
                help: When the Backup was created, by its phase.
                each:
                  type: Gauge
                  gauge: {path: [metadata, creationTimestamp]}
          - groupVersionKind: {group: psmdb.percona.com, version: v1, kind: PerconaServerMongoDB}
            metricNamePrefix: zeabur_psmdb
            labelsFromPath:
              namespace: [metadata, namespace]
              cluster: [metadata, name]
            metrics:
              - name: state
                help: The MongoDB cluster's state.
                each:
                  type: Info
                  info:
                    labelsFromPath:
                      state: [status, state]
          - groupVersionKind: {group: psmdb.percona.com, version: v1, kind: PerconaServerMongoDBBackup}
            metricNamePrefix: zeabur_psmdb_backup
            labelsFromPath:
              namespace: [metadata, namespace]
              backup: [metadata, name]
              cluster: [spec, clusterName]
              state: [status, state]
            metrics:
              - name: created
                help: When the backup was created, by its state.
                each:
                  type: Gauge
                  gauge: {path: [metadata, creationTimestamp]}
          - groupVersionKind: {group: k8up.io, version: v1, kind: Backup}
            metricNamePrefix: zeabur_k8up_backup
            labelsFromPath:
              namespace: [metadata, namespace]
              backup: [metadata, name]
            metrics:
              - name: condition_time
                help: When each condition of the Backup last changed, by type and reason.
                each:
                  type: Gauge
                  gauge:
                    path: [status, conditions]
                    labelsFromPath:
                      type: [type]
                      reason: [reason]
                    valueFrom: [lastTransitionTime]
          - groupVersionKind: {group: velero.io, version: v1, kind: Backup}
            metricNamePrefix: zeabur_velero_backup
            labelsFromPath:
              namespace: [metadata, namespace]
              backup: [metadata, name]
              phase: [status, phase]
            metrics:
              - name: created
                help: When the Velero backup was created, by its phase.
                each:
                  type: Gauge
                  gauge: {path: [metadata, creationTimestamp]}
          - groupVersionKind: {group: cert-manager.io, version: v1, kind: Certificate}
            metricNamePrefix: zeabur_certmanager_certificate
            labelsFromPath:
              namespace: [metadata, namespace]
              certificate: [metadata, name]
            metrics:
              - name: not_after
                help: When the issued certificate expires.
                errorLogV: 5
                each:
                  type: Gauge
                  gauge: {path: [status, notAfter]}
              - name: condition
                help: The Certificate's conditions, 1 when true.
                each:
                  type: Gauge
                  gauge:
                    path: [status, conditions]
                    labelsFromPath:
                      type: [type]
                    valueFrom: [status]
  vmScrape:
    spec:
      endpoints:
        # The chart's endpoint, plus two drops. The rules read failed
        # backups only. Each successful backup adds one series.
        - port: http
          honorLabels: true
          metricRelabelConfigs:
            - action: labeldrop
              regex: (uid|container_id|image_id)
            - action: drop
              if: '{__name__="zeabur_cnpg_backup_created", phase="completed"}'
            - action: drop
              if: '{__name__="zeabur_psmdb_backup_created", state="ready"}'
alertmanager:
  spec:
    # Each project keeps its channels in VMAlertmanagerConfigs. The operator
    # then routes a config only its own namespace's alerts, and refuses one
    # that reads files from the Alertmanager pod.
    disableNamespaceMatcher: false
    arbitraryFSAccessThroughSMs:
      deny: true
    # Routes alerts to configured receivers. Idles near 24Mi.
    resources:
      requests: {cpu: 10m, memory: 32Mi}
      limits: {memory: 128Mi}
vmalert:
  spec:
    # Evaluates the default alert rules. Idles near 40Mi.
    resources:
      requests: {cpu: 10m, memory: 64Mi}
      limits: {memory: 128Mi}
vmsingle:
  spec:
    # One size for both profiles: the operator won't grow a local-path
    # claim or shrink any, and then stops updating vmsingle. local-path
    # ignores the size; on Longhorn, grow the claim when the history no
    # longer fits.
    storage:
      resources:
        requests: {storage: 5Gi}
vmagent:
  spec:
    # 30s cuts scrape cost by a third versus the chart's 20s.
    scrapeInterval: 30s

releases.manifests:
apiVersion: operator.victoriametrics.com/v1beta1
kind: VMRule
metadata:
  name: zeabur-notifications
  namespace: observability
spec:
  groups:
    - name: zeabur-project
      interval: 30s
      rules:
        - alert: ZeaburBuildFailed
          expr: |
            max by (namespace, build, buildrun, reason) (
              zeabur_builder_buildrun_completion_time{phase="Failed"}
            ) > time() - 900
            and on (namespace) kube_namespace_labels{label_zeabur_com_project!=""}
          labels: {zeabur_event: build-failed, zeabur_kind: event, severity: warning}
          annotations:
            summary: "Build {{ $labels.build }} failed ({{ $labels.reason }})."
            description: "BuildRun {{ $labels.buildrun }} in {{ $labels.namespace }} failed with reason {{ $labels.reason }}."
        - alert: ZeaburBuildSucceeded
          expr: |
            max by (namespace, build, buildrun) (
              zeabur_builder_buildrun_completion_time{phase="Succeeded"}
            ) > time() - 900
            and on (namespace) kube_namespace_labels{label_zeabur_com_project!=""}
          labels: {zeabur_event: build-succeeded, zeabur_kind: event, severity: info}
          annotations:
            summary: "Build {{ $labels.build }} succeeded."
            description: "BuildRun {{ $labels.buildrun }} in {{ $labels.namespace }} succeeded."
        # The Deployment controller gives up on a rollout after
        # progressDeadlineSeconds (600 by default).
        - alert: ZeaburDeployFailed
          expr: |
            max by (namespace, deployment) (
              kube_deployment_status_condition{condition="Progressing", status="false"}
            ) == 1
            and on (namespace) kube_namespace_labels{label_zeabur_com_project!=""}
          labels: {zeabur_event: deploy-failed, zeabur_kind: state, severity: warning}
          annotations:
            summary: "Deployment of {{ $labels.deployment }} failed."
            description: "The rollout of {{ $labels.deployment }} in {{ $labels.namespace }} passed its progress deadline."
        # A rollout makes a new ReplicaSet. It succeeded when the
        # Deployment then runs only up-to-date, available replicas. A
        # rollback to an earlier ReplicaSet does not count.
        - alert: ZeaburDeploySucceeded
          expr: |
            max by (namespace, deployment) (
              label_replace(
                (time() - kube_replicaset_created < 1800)
                * on (namespace, replicaset) group_left (owner_name)
                kube_replicaset_owner{owner_kind="Deployment"},
                "deployment", "$1", "owner_name", "(.+)"
              )
            )
            and on (namespace, deployment) (kube_deployment_status_observed_generation == kube_deployment_metadata_generation)
            and on (namespace, deployment) (kube_deployment_status_replicas_updated == kube_deployment_spec_replicas)
            and on (namespace, deployment) (kube_deployment_status_replicas_available == kube_deployment_spec_replicas)
            and on (namespace, deployment) (kube_deployment_status_replicas == kube_deployment_spec_replicas)
            and on (namespace, deployment) (kube_deployment_spec_replicas > 0)
            and on (namespace) kube_namespace_labels{label_zeabur_com_project!=""}
          labels: {zeabur_event: deploy-succeeded, zeabur_kind: event, severity: info}
          annotations:
            summary: "{{ $labels.deployment }} is deployed."
            description: "All replicas of {{ $labels.deployment }} in {{ $labels.namespace }} run the new version."
        - alert: ZeaburCrashLooping
          expr: |
            max by (namespace, pod, container) (
              kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{reason="CrashLoopBackOff"}
            ) == 1
            and on (namespace) kube_namespace_labels{label_zeabur_com_project!=""}
          for: 5m
          labels: {zeabur_event: crash-loop, zeabur_kind: state, severity: warning}
          annotations:
            summary: "{{ $labels.pod }} keeps crashing."
            description: "Container {{ $labels.container }} of {{ $labels.pod }} in {{ $labels.namespace }} has been in CrashLoopBackOff for 5 minutes."
        - alert: ZeaburOutOfMemory
          expr: |
            max by (namespace, pod, container) (
              kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{reason="OOMKilled"}
            ) == 1
            and on (namespace, pod, container) (
              max by (namespace, pod, container) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total[10m])) > 0
            )
            and on (namespace) kube_namespace_labels{label_zeabur_com_project!=""}
          labels: {zeabur_event: out-of-memory, zeabur_kind: event, severity: warning}
          annotations:
            summary: "{{ $labels.pod }} ran out of memory."
            description: "Container {{ $labels.container }} of {{ $labels.pod }} in {{ $labels.namespace }} used its memory limit and restarted."
        # Without the phase in the grouping, a move from one unhealthy
        # phase to another does not restart the 15 minutes.
        - alert: ZeaburPostgresUnhealthy
          expr: |
            max by (namespace, cluster) (
              zeabur_cnpg_cluster_phase{phase!="Cluster in healthy state"}
            ) == 1
            and on (namespace) kube_namespace_labels{label_zeabur_com_project!=""}
          for: 15m
          labels: {zeabur_event: database-unhealthy, zeabur_kind: state, severity: critical}
          annotations:
            summary: "PostgreSQL {{ $labels.cluster }} is not healthy."
            description: "PostgreSQL cluster {{ $labels.cluster }} in {{ $labels.namespace }} has not been healthy for 15 minutes."
        - alert: ZeaburMongoDBUnhealthy
          expr: |
            max by (namespace, cluster) (zeabur_psmdb_state{state="error"}) == 1
            and on (namespace) kube_namespace_labels{label_zeabur_com_project!=""}
          for: 10m
          labels: {zeabur_event: database-unhealthy, zeabur_kind: state, severity: critical}
          annotations:
            summary: "MongoDB {{ $labels.cluster }} is in error."
            description: "MongoDB cluster {{ $labels.cluster }} in {{ $labels.namespace }} has been in error for 10 minutes."
        - alert: ZeaburPostgresBackupFailed
          expr: |
            max by (namespace, cluster, backup) (
              zeabur_cnpg_backup_created{phase=~"failed|walArchivingFailing"}
            ) > time() - 21600
            and on (namespace) kube_namespace_labels{label_zeabur_com_project!=""}
          labels: {zeabur_event: backup-failed, zeabur_kind: event, severity: critical}
          annotations:
            summary: "Backup {{ $labels.backup }} of PostgreSQL {{ $labels.cluster }} failed."
            description: "Backup {{ $labels.backup }} in {{ $labels.namespace }} failed."
        - alert: ZeaburMongoDBBackupFailed
          expr: |
            max by (namespace, cluster, backup) (
              zeabur_psmdb_backup_created{state=~"error|rejected"}
            ) > time() - 21600
            and on (namespace) kube_namespace_labels{label_zeabur_com_project!=""}
          labels: {zeabur_event: backup-failed, zeabur_kind: event, severity: critical}
          annotations:
            summary: "Backup {{ $labels.backup }} of MongoDB {{ $labels.cluster }} failed."
            description: "Backup {{ $labels.backup }} in {{ $labels.namespace }} failed."
        - alert: ZeaburVolumeBackupFailed
          expr: |
            max by (namespace, backup) (
              zeabur_k8up_backup_condition_time{type="Completed", reason="Failed"}
            ) > time() - 21600
            and on (namespace) kube_namespace_labels{label_zeabur_com_project!=""}
          labels: {zeabur_event: backup-failed, zeabur_kind: event, severity: critical}
          annotations:
            summary: "Volume backup {{ $labels.backup }} failed."
            description: "K8up backup {{ $labels.backup }} in {{ $labels.namespace }} failed."
        # Volumes on local-path report no usage; this covers the others.
        - alert: ZeaburVolumeAlmostFull
          expr: |
            max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (
              kubelet_volume_stats_available_bytes / kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes
            ) < 0.1
            and on (namespace) kube_namespace_labels{label_zeabur_com_project!=""}
          for: 10m
          labels: {zeabur_event: volume-almost-full, zeabur_kind: state, severity: warning}
          annotations:
            summary: "Volume {{ $labels.persistentvolumeclaim }} is almost full."
            description: "Less than 10% of volume {{ $labels.persistentvolumeclaim }} in {{ $labels.namespace }} is free."
        # cert-manager renews 30 days before expiry, so 14 days left
        # means renewal keeps failing.
        - alert: ZeaburCertificateExpiring
          expr: |
            max by (namespace, certificate) (zeabur_certmanager_certificate_not_after) - time() < 14 * 86400
            and on (namespace) kube_namespace_labels{label_zeabur_com_project!=""}
          labels: {zeabur_event: certificate, zeabur_kind: state, severity: warning}
          annotations:
            summary: "Certificate {{ $labels.certificate }} expires soon."
            description: "Certificate {{ $labels.certificate }} in {{ $labels.namespace }} expires in less than 14 days and was not renewed."
        - alert: ZeaburCertificateNotReady
          expr: |
            max by (namespace, certificate) (zeabur_certmanager_certificate_condition{type="Ready"}) == 0
            and on (namespace) kube_namespace_labels{label_zeabur_com_project!=""}
          for: 1h
          labels: {zeabur_event: certificate, zeabur_kind: state, severity: warning}
          annotations:
            summary: "Certificate {{ $labels.certificate }} is not ready."
            description: "Certificate {{ $labels.certificate }} in {{ $labels.namespace }} has not been issued for an hour."
        # Zeabur creates a short-lived Job with this label to test a
        # channel. The namespace comes from the Job, so a person can
        # only test the channels of a namespace where they create Jobs.
        - alert: ZeaburNotificationTest
          expr: |
            label_replace(
              max by (namespace, label_zeabur_com_notification_test) (
                kube_job_labels{label_zeabur_com_notification_test!=""}
              ),
              "zeabur_channel", "$1", "label_zeabur_com_notification_test", "(.+)"
            )
          labels: {zeabur_event: test, zeabur_kind: event, severity: info}
          annotations:
            summary: "Test notification from Zeabur."
            description: "This channel receives notifications from {{ $labels.namespace }}."
    - name: zeabur-cluster
      interval: 30s
      # The cluster's channels are in observability.
      labels: {namespace: observability}
      rules:
        - alert: ZeaburNodeNotReady
          expr: |
            max by (node) (kube_node_status_condition{condition="Ready", status="true"}) == 0
          for: 5m
          labels: {zeabur_event: node-not-ready, zeabur_kind: state, severity: critical}
          annotations:
            summary: "Node {{ $labels.node }} is not ready."
            description: "Node {{ $labels.node }} has not been ready for 5 minutes."
        - alert: ZeaburNodeDiskAlmostFull
          expr: |
            max by (instance, mountpoint) (
              node_filesystem_avail_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|ramfs"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{fstype!~"tmpfs|ramfs"}
            ) < 0.1
          for: 10m
          labels: {zeabur_event: volume-almost-full, zeabur_kind: state, severity: warning}
          annotations:
            summary: "Disk {{ $labels.mountpoint }} on {{ $labels.instance }} is almost full."
            description: "Less than 10% of {{ $labels.mountpoint }} on {{ $labels.instance }} is free."
        - alert: ZeaburSystemCrashLooping
          expr: |
            label_move(
              max by (namespace, pod, container) (
                kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{reason="CrashLoopBackOff"}
              ) == 1
              unless on (namespace) kube_namespace_labels{label_zeabur_com_project!=""},
              "namespace", "object_namespace"
            )
          for: 5m
          labels: {zeabur_event: crash-loop, zeabur_kind: state, severity: critical}
          annotations:
            summary: "System pod {{ $labels.pod }} keeps crashing."
            description: "Container {{ $labels.container }} of {{ $labels.pod }} in {{ $labels.object_namespace }} has been in CrashLoopBackOff for 5 minutes."
        - alert: ZeaburSystemVolumeAlmostFull
          expr: |
            label_move(
              max by (namespace, persistentvolumeclaim) (
                kubelet_volume_stats_available_bytes / kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes
              ) < 0.1
              unless on (namespace) kube_namespace_labels{label_zeabur_com_project!=""},
              "namespace", "object_namespace"
            )
          for: 10m
          labels: {zeabur_event: volume-almost-full, zeabur_kind: state, severity: warning}
          annotations:
            summary: "Volume {{ $labels.persistentvolumeclaim }} is almost full."
            description: "Less than 10% of volume {{ $labels.persistentvolumeclaim }} in {{ $labels.object_namespace }} is free."
        - alert: ZeaburSystemCertificateExpiring
          expr: |
            label_move(
              max by (namespace, certificate) (zeabur_certmanager_certificate_not_after) - time() < 14 * 86400
              unless on (namespace) kube_namespace_labels{label_zeabur_com_project!=""},
              "namespace", "object_namespace"
            )
          labels: {zeabur_event: certificate, zeabur_kind: state, severity: warning}
          annotations:
            summary: "Certificate {{ $labels.certificate }} expires soon."
            description: "Certificate {{ $labels.certificate }} in {{ $labels.object_namespace }} expires in less than 14 days and was not renewed."
        - alert: ZeaburClusterBackupFailed
          expr: |
            label_move(
              max by (namespace, backup) (
                zeabur_velero_backup_created{phase=~"Failed|PartiallyFailed|FailedValidation"}
              ) > time() - 21600,
              "namespace", "object_namespace"
            )
          labels: {zeabur_event: backup-failed, zeabur_kind: event, severity: critical}
          annotations:
            summary: "Cluster backup {{ $labels.backup }} failed."
            description: "Velero backup {{ $labels.backup }} did not complete."
---
# Only the alert senders and the scraper reach Alertmanager. Without
# this, any pod could post alerts with another project's namespace, or
# silence them. kubectl port-forward does not pass through
# NetworkPolicies, so it still works.
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: vmalertmanager-senders-only
  namespace: observability
spec:
  podSelector:
    matchLabels: {app.kubernetes.io/name: vmalertmanager}
  policyTypes: [Ingress]
  ingress:
    - from:
        - podSelector:
            matchLabels: {app.kubernetes.io/name: vmalert}
      ports:
        - {port: 9093, protocol: TCP}
    - from:
        - namespaceSelector:
            matchLabels: {kubernetes.io/metadata.name: falco}
          podSelector:
            matchLabels: {app.kubernetes.io/name: falcosidekick}
      ports:
        - {port: 9093, protocol: TCP}
    - from:
        - podSelector:
            matchLabels: {app.kubernetes.io/name: vmagent}
      ports:
        - {port: 9093, protocol: TCP}
        - {port: 8435, protocol: TCP}
    # Replicas gossip silences and notification state.
    - from:
        - podSelector:
            matchLabels: {app.kubernetes.io/name: vmalertmanager}
      ports:
        - {port: 9094, protocol: TCP}
        - {port: 9094, protocol: UDP}
releases.name: notifications

security.summary: Manages VictoriaMetrics objects, scrapes pods in all namespaces, and reads builds, databases, backups and certificates in all namespaces for alerts. node-exporter reads the host's /proc and /sys on the host network.
